description: Kwento: Kilabot Tagalog horror Reels/Shorts — vertical 720p 24 fps, off-screen narrator, final under 9.5 MB.
visual_checklist: Each clip shows its expected visual (expected_visuals), in story order, no repeated shot
No text, subtitles, watermark or logos; no garbled faces or hands

Look: foggy night, eerie Filipino setting — no clip breaks the mood (bright daylight, cartoonish look)
